_provenance: VERIFIED SHAPE, from fal's own schema page for bytedance/seedance-2.0/image-to-video, read 2026-08-20. The documented output is exactly `{ video: { url, content_type, file_name, file_size }, seed }`, and the example on the model-api-reference page shows a response with only `video.url` and `seed` populated -- which is why scripts/providers/fal.mjs requires `video.url` and treats every other field as optional decoration. NOTE `seed`: the response reports the seed the model used, and whether it equals the one we sent is an open question recorded in config/models.json. It is stored as meta.providerSeed rather than assumed.
